additional_info.subject: ID0441936-DC/Si-D/DE-[Y2/S5 313647928001] Issue with charging station CRM:00315002894
additional_info.body:
Dear Jan, good morning. I hope you are doing well.
We have found the error which relates to a communication problem with the AC charging. In order to ascertain if the root cause is the same, there is a fix in the latest FW version.
Please let me know if I can install it and when I can do it. Please confirm that no one is connected to the charging station as well in order to avoid creating problems during the update.
I will wait for your feedback.
Thanks and have a nice day!
Best regards,
Francisco
